d:
Chhath Puja 2026 :chhath mahaparv ki shuruaat kal nahay-khay ke sath hone ja rahi hai. ise lekar patna men taiyariyan lagbhag puri kar li gaee hain. shraddhaluon ki suvidha aur suraksha ko dekhte hue patna traiphik pulis ne 15 aur 16 navanbar ke lie vishesh traiphik plan jari kiya hai. in do dinon men shahar ke kaee ilakon men yatayat pratibandh aur rut men badlav lagu rahenge. chhath ghat jane se pahle janie patna ka pura traiphik plan aur kin raston par rahegi pabandi.
